newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Garanti bank may sell bank unit.
newsitem.headline: Turk Garanti bank may sell bank unit.

text.p: T. Garanti Bankasi A.S., one of Turkey's big private banks, said it began talks to sell its banking subsidiary Bankekspres.

"We are at a preliminary stage in the sale of Bankekspres. Buying or selling a bank depends on the Treasury's approval. Before that, preliminary talks can't reach a conclusion," the bank said in a statement sent to the Istanbul Stock Exchange on Monday.
"At this stage, there is no decision taken by the bank management to sell (Bankekspres)," it added.
The statement also said Garanti bank owned 1.71 trillion lira worth Bankekspres shares, making up 85.54 percent of its capital and the whole stake would be subject to sale.
"A detailed information will be given after the board's decision concerning the sale," the statement added.
The Exchange had temporarily suspended trading in shares of Garanti bank on Friday on press reports that Bankekspres was being sold.
